results.content:
What Scribe does:
→ Draft full messages from a rough command. Say "write a follow-up to John about the design review" and Scribe drafts the email in your voice.
→ Reply in context. Inside an email or Slack thread, say "reply and tell him I'll send the deck by Friday" and Scribe reads the thread and writes the response.
→ Edit anything you highlight. Select text, hit your hotkey, say "make this clearer" or "rewrite this in Mandarin." Done.
Scribe works in every app you already write in, with full awareness of the document or thread around you.
